items.title: Expedia to Buy Kiwi.com, Extending Its Acquisition Spree Into Flights
items.why: Online travel consolidation may reshape which booking platforms issuers can route card travel benefits and offers through.
items.summary_ai: Expedia plans to acquire Kiwi.com, extending its acquisition strategy into flight booking.
items.take: Online travel consolidation may reshape which booking platforms issuers can route card travel benefits and offers through.

items.title: The Pressures on Expedia B2B
items.why: Weaker B2B economics could make travel-portal partners more open to card-linked deals and better terms.
items.summary_ai: Expedia's B2B partner business, long a growth engine, faces a slowdown and rising pressure from rival Booking Holdings.
items.take: Weaker B2B economics could make travel-portal partners more open to card-linked deals and better terms.
